scope: Minimal bcod-sim contract revision from 16 to 17 observation fields.
ahrs_caveat: The orientation field consumed in this revision is a noise-free attitude estimate. It corresponds to an idealized AHRS output, not to a heading integrated from the noisy gyro channel. Results obtained with it are an upper bound on what a real attitude sensor would provide. Orientation noise is a planned follow-up and any later result including it is not directly comparable to this one.
historical_comparability: Prior v3-v7 and heading-oracle results were produced under the initial-heading bug and are not directly comparable to results produced under this corrected contract.
